<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

Bring the MI45x (gfx1250) image onto ROCm 10.1. It is published alongside the existing ROCm 10.0 images rather than replacing them, so nothing consuming the current `rocm10-*` tags changes.

## Modifications

**torch 2.11 → 2.12.** ROCm 10.1 publishes no torch 2.11 wheel, so the bump comes with the SDK. torchvision moves 0.26 → 0.27 and torchaudio stays on 2.11.
`srt_hip_rocm101` carries the 2.12 pin, mirroring `srt_hip_rocm724`.
**Triton comes from the SDK.** This flavor sets `BUILD_TRITON=0` and keeps `3.8.0+git669b31ac` as shipped with ROCm 10.1, instead of the source build the 10.0 flavor uses. 



## Accuracy Tests

### ROCm 10.1 

| Model       | Status                        | 
| ----------- | ----------------------------- | 
| gpt-oss tp1 | pass                          | 
| dsr1 tp2    | pass                          | 
| dsv4 tp4    | pass                          | 
| wan2.2 tp1  | pass (with #42858 and #42859) | 
| flux2 tp1   | pass (with #42858)            | 
## Speed Tests and Profiling

torch.profiler needs #44292 to produce GPU traces on this image.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

nodes.body:
Triggered a test build of the ROCm 10.1 gfx1250 image from this branch:

**Run:** https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38671327370 (`job_select=publish-gfx1250-rocm101`)

Expected output, to `rocm/sgl-dev` only:

```
rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.21-rocm101-mi45x-20261015-test
```

The `-test` suffix and the dropped `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm` mirror are both marked `TEMPORARY` in the workflow and will be removed once the image checks out.

The other two jobs were skipped, so the released ROCm 10.0 tags are untouched. For reference, what this workflow publishes once the temporary bits are gone:

| Job | GPU_ARCH | Tag |
|---|---|---|
| `publish` | `gfx942-rocm1000` | `v<version>-rocm10-mi30x-<date>` |
| `publish` | `gfx950-rocm1000` | `v<version>-rocm10-mi35x-<date>` |
| `publish-gfx1250` | `gfx1250-rocm1000` | `v<version>-rocm10-mi45x-<date>` |
| `publish-gfx1250-rocm101` | `gfx1250-rocm1010` | `v<version>-rocm101-mi45x-<date>` |

ROCm 10.0 and 10.1 are published side by side rather than one replacing the other. The 10.1 image is a separate `gfx1250-rocm1010` Dockerfile stage because `BUILD_TRITON` is an `ENV`, not an `ARG`, and the two flavors need different values: 10.0 builds Triton from source, 10.1 keeps the one the SDK ships.

+  publish-gfx1250-rocm101:
+    if: github.repository == 'sgl-project/sglang' && (github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' || inputs.job_select == 'all' || inputs.job_select == 'publish-gfx1250-rocm101')
+    runs-on: amd-docker-scale
+    environment: 'prod'
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout repository
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      - name: Set up Python
+        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
+        with:
+          python-version: '3.10'
+
+      - name: Set date
+        run: echo "DATE=$(date +%Y%m%d)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+
+      - name: Get version from latest tag
+        id: version
+        run: |
+          VERSION=$(python3 scripts/release/get_version_tag.py --tag-only | sed 's/^v//')
+
+          if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then
+            echo "::error::Could not determine version from git tags"
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+          COMMIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
+          PRETEND_VERSION="${VERSION}.dev${DATE}+g${COMMIT_HASH}"
+
+          echo "version=${VERSION}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "pretend_version=${PRETEND_VERSION}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+      - name: Login to Docker Hub (AMD)
+        uses: docker/login-action@v3
+        with:
+          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_AMD_USERNAME }}
+          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_AMD_TOKEN }}
+
+      - name: Build and push to rocm/sgl-dev
+        env:
+          PRETEND_VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.pretend_version }}
+          VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
+        run: |
+          image_tag="v${VERSION}-rocm101-mi45x-${DATE}"
+          echo "IMAGE_TAG=${image_tag}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+
+          docker build . \
+            -f docker/rocm.Dockerfile \
+            --build-arg "SGL_BRANCH=${GITHUB_SHA}" \
+            --build-arg BUILD_TYPE=all \
+            --build-arg GPU_ARCH=gfx1250-rocm1010 \
+            --build-arg ENABLE_MORI=0 \
+            --build-arg ENABLE_NIXL=1 \
+            --build-arg "SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION=${PRETEND_VERSION}" \
+            --build-arg UBUNTU_MIRROR=https://archive.ubuntu.com \
+            -t "rocm/sgl-dev:${image_tag}" \
+            --no-cache
+          docker push "rocm/sgl-dev:${image_tag}"
+
+      - name: Login to Docker Hub (lmsys)
+        uses: docker/login-action@v3
+        with:
+          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
+          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}
+
+      - name: Push to lmsysorg/sglang-rocm
+        run: |
+          docker tag "rocm/sgl-dev:${IMAGE_TAG}" "lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:${IMAGE_TAG}"
+          docker push "lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:${IMAGE_TAG}"
+
   # gfx1250 (MI45x) runs on the same schedule as the pair above but stays a
   # separate job: no MI450 runner pool consumes the image, so a bring-up build
   # failure must not gate the released gfx942/gfx950 images.

issue_comments.body:
Triggered a test build of the ROCm 10.1 gfx1250 image from this branch:

**Run:** https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38671327370 (`job_select=publish-gfx1250-rocm101`)

Expected output, to `rocm/sgl-dev` only:

```
rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.21-rocm101-mi45x-20261015-test
```

The `-test` suffix and the dropped `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm` mirror are both marked `TEMPORARY` in the workflow and will be removed once the image checks out.

The other two jobs were skipped, so the released ROCm 10.0 tags are untouched. For reference, what this workflow publishes once the temporary bits are gone:

| Job | GPU_ARCH | Tag |
|---|---|---|
| `publish` | `gfx942-rocm1000` | `v<version>-rocm10-mi30x-<date>` |
| `publish` | `gfx950-rocm1000` | `v<version>-rocm10-mi35x-<date>` |
| `publish-gfx1250` | `gfx1250-rocm1000` | `v<version>-rocm10-mi45x-<date>` |
| `publish-gfx1250-rocm101` | `gfx1250-rocm1010` | `v<version>-rocm101-mi45x-<date>` |

ROCm 10.0 and 10.1 are published side by side rather than one replacing the other. The 10.1 image is a separate `gfx1250-rocm1010` Dockerfile stage because `BUILD_TRITON` is an `ENV`, not an `ARG`, and the two flavors need different values: 10.0 builds Triton from source, 10.1 keeps the one the SDK ships.
